test_title: PYST 06: RRB ALP CBT I - Reasoning (Held On: 26 Nov 2024 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. A sits second to the left of B. E sits to an immediate left of A. C sits to the immediate right of F. What is the position of C with respect to D?
solution:
Given: A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. 

1) A sits second to the left of B. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4341875daf437eaeb38960653897046b4b4b5ebb53b595259ab2d11d4fb86ba1.png] 

2) E sits to an immediate left of A. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/adba01be089eea06fefe12e6c2bcf7e113a6e6ea36d0e41d6b97844909b4be74.png] 

3) C sits to the immediate right of F.

After positioning C and F only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e. D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7c7471297d29137f3ee7d9e940d49c32e3529d93dd80a13833a750c4649c0f14.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement, C sits third to the left of D.

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
